{{Quote|My brother cares deeply about his blood family, including me. But he's disturbed by what he sees as my self-destructive behavior&hellip;and as a syndic of the Eighth Ruling Family, his duty is to protect that family's honor and position.''"<br />"''So he calls an ''admiral'' down on you?|Thrawn and Car'das, after Thrass calls Admiral Ar'alani back to Crustai|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
The [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Mitth'ras'safis/Legends|Mitth'ras'safis]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Thrass," of the [[Mitth family/Legends|Eighth Ruling Family]] along with his brother, [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], core name "Thrawn," of the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]] once belonged to a '''blood family''' of commoners that was a part of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

Following the [[Battle of Geroon]], Thrass warned Thrawn that the Eighth Family would [[Rematching/Legends|release]] him to his original family before his actions could damage their standing within the [[Ruling Families/Legends|Ruling Families]]. Ignoring Thrass' warning, Thrawn reminded him that they were both [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] as commoners and that he could live that way again. He promised his brother that he would do what he could so his actions wouldn't damage Thrass' position within the Eighth Ruling Family.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

{{Chiss-stub}}
